info.name: WeCook API
info.description:
RESTful backend API specification for the WeCook recipe sharing social platform.

### Authentication
Authentication is based on secure, HttpOnly JWT cookies:
- **`accessToken`**: Short-lived (10 minutes) JWT sent automatically by browsers or HTTP clients on protected endpoints.
- **`refreshToken`**: Long-lived (7 days) JWT restricted to the `/api/auth/refresh` path.

### Media Storage & Static Assets
Uploaded recipe covers, step images, gallery photos, videos, and user avatars are served statically under `/uploads/`.

### Localization & Multilingual Engine
Recipes and catalogs support Italian (`it`), English (`en`), and French (`fr`), powered by LibreTranslate relational projection.
